overloads.semanticRole: The Is field value Null command returns True if the field designated by the aField parameter contains the NULL value, and False otherwise.

constraints: The return value is only meaningful if the "Map NULL values to blank values" option is NOT checked in the field's definition in the Structure editor; if it is checked, this command always returns False.
Cannot be used with object fields or object properties; use the Null command instead for those.
